description: Run the wg-easy WireGuard server in Docker. WireGuard on 51820/udp; admin web UI on loopback 51821 (reached over the tunnel). Complete the first-run setup wizard in the web UI.

steps.description: Verify Docker is installed (install Docker first if this fails).
Start the wg-easy container (v15). Admin UI bound to loopback :51821; VPN on 51820/udp.
steps.run: docker run -d --name wg-easy --restart unless-stopped -v ~/.wg-easy:/etc/wireguard -p 51820:51820/udp -p 127.0.0.1:51821:51821/tcp --cap-add NET_ADMIN --cap-add SYS_MODULE --sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 --sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.src_valid_mark=1 ghcr.io/wg-easy/wg-easy:15

uninstall.description: Stop and remove the wg-easy container and its data.
